caption: The drawing features an interior setting densely packed with objects and furnishings. In the upper part of the image, there are luxurious draped curtains in gold, beige, and patterned red, tied to ornate poles. Mounted on the left side are a shield, two crossed swords, and a spear, all in muted metallic shades. Below the curtains, a bed or divan is covered with richly decorated textiles in red, blue, green, pink, and gold, with several intricately patterned pillows. On one side of the divan stands a small ornate table holding a silver hookah and a blue-and-white jug. Behind the bed or divan is a multicolored peacock-feather design tapestry, bordered by two gilded picture frames with blank white spaces. Hanging from above is a golden lamp with colored designs. Large green palm leaves are situated near the right side, among which are a bronze or brass vase, a pink lamp with a round fringed shade, and a small statue of a dark-skinned woman in gold garments and red accessories. The background walls are decorated with subtle gray patterns and partially visible geometric designs. An American flag is partially visible behind the left curtain. The entire scene is rendered with fine detail, emphasizing various textures and patterns, with a dominant color palette of gold, red, green, and purple.
title: Setting (interior)
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
